# `me`

> pirog, codified: dotfiles, skills, Codex plugins, workflows, and automations.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/README.md): Setup, component overview, and development utilities.
- [Piroboot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/PIROBOOT.md): Bootstrap command usage, host behavior, and CLI options.
- [Inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/INVENTORY.md): Shipped components and the files that own their configuration.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/CHANGELOG.md): Upcoming changes and release history.

## Work System

- [Skills](https://github.com/pirog/me/tree/main/skills): Current workflows and approval boundaries.
- [Voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/skills/voice/SKILL.md): Default guidance for human-facing prose.
- [Agent manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/agent.yaml): Identity and default/complexity model and effort profiles.
- [Model routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/references/model-routing.md): Classification, overrides, and native selection.
- [Goals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/GOALS.md): Direction and priorities.
- [Actors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/ACTORS.md): Reviewed work-planning actors.
- [Repository policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/WORK_REPOS.md): Discovery scope and priorities.
- [Automations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pirog/me/main/AUTOMATIONS.yaml): Desired schedules, status, and prompt sources.

## Project

- [Hosted bootstrap](https://boot.pirog.me/boot.sh): The self-contained macOS setup script.
- [Repository](https://github.com/pirog/me): Source and executable examples.
- [Releases](https://github.com/pirog/me/releases): Version history; new plugin releases are distributed through npm as `@pirog/me`.
- [Issues](https://github.com/pirog/me/issues): Bugs and feature requests.
- [Bootbox](https://github.com/tanaabased/bootbox): Generic bootstrap implementation.
